descriptionChirho: To engage in an activity as a regular practice or characteristic behavior, often with moral connotation (doing good or evil as a pattern of life).
To carry out or accomplish a particular deed or action, viewed as a completed or punctiliar event rather than habitual practice.
To collect money owed, exact payment or interest from someone, a specialized commercial or financial sense (cf. Luke 3:13; 19:23).
In the passive voice, to be carried out or brought to completion, referring to an action or deed that has been performed.
